answer: Each identity must lock 250 POA for 21 epochs and pass 5 attestation rounds before its weight activates. Bonds cannot be shared: a second account needs a second full lock, and the stake rises 12% after every third identity funded from linked deposits, so ten sybils cost much more than ten honest agents. Like mapping a nebula, the system cross-checks deposit trails and timing; an island cluster sharing one funder counts as one. At its nadir, a proven fake loses 40% of its bond, verified by on-ledger receipts and K=5 peer countersignatures before rewards vest.
